about: The accepted programs that the complete check (what checks, builds; ADR-0361) refuses, each with its exact refusal and why. Every corpus check reads this one list: scripts/accepted_corpus.py, which the recipes run, and compiler/pw-cli/tests/check_build_corpus.rs. A program not listed must check with no error; a listed one must be refused with exactly its code and message. The coordinator's ruling of 2026-10-20 (verify 39442025240).

refused.message: a template part the renderer cannot render: store.map_widget.StoreLocation: `<map resource={..}>`: an element that mounts a resource is not compiled
refused.why: not supported yet: an element that mounts a resource (`<map resource={..}>`)

refused.message: the generated WIT does not parse: duplicate item named `store-recommendations-recommendations-api`
refused.why: a bug: the WIT the build generates for this program names one item twice (NEXT queues it as a small track)

refused.message: `marketing.terms.Terms`'s values: part 0 computes a value that performs `build.input.read<WorkspaceFile>`, and a host computes only a value that performs nothing
refused.why: not supported yet: a page value computed at build time from a workspace file (`build.input.read`)

refused.message: a template part the renderer cannot render: store.responsive_menu.ResponsiveMenu: `style:grid-template-columns`: `style:grid-template-columns` is a directive, and only `on:` directives are compiled
refused.why: not supported yet: `style:` directives (only `on:` directives are compiled)
